title: feat(contacts): show the avatar in the contact list
description: Shows each contact's avatar before its name in the contact list. The avatar is decorative: the name next to it says who it is.
rationale: The `` has no `width` and `height` (and no reserved size in CSS): each row grows when its avatar loads, so the list shifts under the user (CLS, a Core Web Vital), and nothing is lazy-loaded on a long list. Give it its dimensions.
